authorization_signatures_target.name: authorization_signatures_target
authorization_signatures_target.value: ("authorization_signatures"."profile_id" = 'self' and "authorization_signatures"."managed_profile_id" is null) or ("authorization_signatures"."profile_id" = "authorization_signatures"."managed_profile_id" and "authorization_signatures"."managed_profile_id" is not null)

client_activities_bounds.name: client_activities_bounds
client_activities_bounds.value: "client_activities"."revision" >= 0 and length("client_activities"."title") between 1 and 200 and length("client_activities"."description") <= 8000 and length("client_activities"."timezone") between 1 and 100

client_activities_schedule.name: client_activities_schedule
client_activities_schedule.value: ("client_activities"."kind" not in ('event','appointment') or "client_activities"."starts_at" is not null) and ("client_activities"."ends_at" is null or ("client_activities"."starts_at" is not null and "client_activities"."ends_at" >= "client_activities"."starts_at"))

action_center_manual_bounds.name: action_center_manual_bounds
action_center_manual_bounds.value: "action_center_manual_reviews"."revision" >= 0 and "action_center_manual_reviews"."state" in ('requested','in_progress','resolved') and length("action_center_manual_reviews"."response") between 1 and 2000 and ("action_center_manual_reviews"."state"<>'resolved' or ("action_center_manual_reviews"."resolution" is not null and length("action_center_manual_reviews"."resolution") between 1 and 2000))

action_center_resolution_target.name: action_center_resolution_target
action_center_resolution_target.value: ("action_center_resolutions"."profile_id"='self' and "action_center_resolutions"."managed_profile_id" is null) or ("action_center_resolutions"."profile_id"="action_center_resolutions"."managed_profile_id" and "action_center_resolutions"."managed_profile_id" is not null)

action_center_resolution_bounds.name: action_center_resolution_bounds
action_center_resolution_bounds.value: "action_center_resolutions"."action_id" ~ '^act_[0-9a-f]{32}$' and "action_center_resolutions"."observed_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "action_center_resolutions"."profile_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "action_center_resolutions"."fingerprint" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and length("action_center_resolutions"."topic") between 1 and 100 and jsonb_typeof("action_center_resolutions"."history")='object'

company_service_requests_target.name: company_service_requests_target
company_service_requests_target.value: ("company_service_requests"."profile_id" = 'self' and "company_service_requests"."managed_profile_id" is null) or ("company_service_requests"."profile_id" = "company_service_requests"."managed_profile_id" and "company_service_requests"."managed_profile_id" is not null)

company_service_requests_bounds.name: company_service_requests_bounds
company_service_requests_bounds.value: "company_service_requests"."revision" >= 0 and "company_service_requests"."profile_revision" >= 0 and jsonb_typeof("company_service_requests"."values") = 'object' and octet_length("company_service_requests"."values"::text) <= 8192 and "company_service_requests"."values_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and length("company_service_requests"."profile_name") between 1 and 160

document_change_requests_bounds.name: document_change_requests_bounds
document_change_requests_bounds.value: length("document_change_requests"."previous_value") between 1 and 240 and length("document_change_requests"."requested_value") between 1 and 240 and length("document_change_requests"."insurer") between 1 and 160

document_identity_attachment_mode.name: document_identity_attachment_mode
document_identity_attachment_mode.value: "document_identity_attachments"."combined_id" is null or ("document_identity_attachments"."front_id" is null and "document_identity_attachments"."back_id" is null)

document_identity_attachment_faces.name: document_identity_attachment_faces
document_identity_attachment_faces.value: "document_identity_attachments"."front_id" is null or "document_identity_attachments"."back_id" is null or "document_identity_attachments"."front_id" <> "document_identity_attachments"."back_id"

files_profile_assignment_target.name: files_profile_assignment_target
files_profile_assignment_target.value: "files"."profile_assignment" is null or "files"."profile_assignment" in ('matched','created','manual') or ("files"."managed_profile_id" is null and "files"."profile_assigned_at" is null)

managed_document_identity_attachment_mod.name: managed_document_identity_attachment_mode
managed_document_identity_attachment_mod.value: "managed_document_identity_attachments"."combined_id" is null or ("managed_document_identity_attachments"."front_id" is null and "managed_document_identity_attachments"."back_id" is null)

managed_document_identity_attachment_fac.name: managed_document_identity_attachment_faces
managed_document_identity_attachment_fac.value: "managed_document_identity_attachments"."front_id" is null or "managed_document_identity_attachments"."back_id" is null or "managed_document_identity_attachments"."front_id" <> "managed_document_identity_attachments"."back_id"

profile_audit_actor.name: profile_audit_actor
profile_audit_actor.value: "profile_audit_events"."user_id" is not null or "profile_audit_events"."draft_id" is not null

profile_audit_session.name: profile_audit_session
profile_audit_session.value: "profile_audit_events"."session_id" is null or "profile_audit_events"."user_id" is not null

profile_commands_scope.name: profile_commands_scope
profile_commands_scope.value: ("profile_commands"."draft_id" is not null and "profile_commands"."endpoint" = 'save_draft') or ("profile_commands"."user_id" is not null and "profile_commands"."endpoint" in ('save', 'confirm', 'attach'))

partner_lead_closure.name: partner_lead_closure
partner_lead_closure.value: ("partner_leads"."stage" = 'completed') = ("partner_leads"."result" is not null and "partner_leads"."reason" is not null)

partner_lead_profile.name: partner_lead_profile
partner_lead_profile.value: "partner_leads"."client_profile_id" is null or "partner_leads"."client_user_id" is not null

managed_profile_sections_kind.name: managed_profile_sections_kind
managed_profile_sections_kind.value: "managed_profile_sections"."section" in ('general','finances','health') and ("managed_profile_sections"."managed_profile_id" is not null or "managed_profile_sections"."section" <> 'general')
